claims.summary: The origin protects rights guaranteed by the Utah Constitution; the descendant has no reference to the Utah Constitution.
The descendant protects rights guaranteed by the Minnesota Constitution, a reference the origin lacks.
The origin is numbered section 78B-25-111 and applies the construction rule to 'this chapter'; the descendant lacks this numbering and wording.
The descendant is numbered Sec. 31 [554.17] and applies the construction rule to sections 554.07 to 554.19, which the origin does not mention.

unusable_attempts: no claim cites spans that exist and differ (claim 1: s3 is on one side only, so it shows text one side lacks, not a change; claim 2: s0 is on one side only, so it shows text one side lacks, not a change)

claims.summary: The descendant protects rights guaranteed by the U.S. Constitution or the Minnesota Constitution; the origin refers to the Utah Constitution.
The descendant applies the construction rule to sections 554.07 to 554.19 ("must" be construed); the origin applies it to "this chapter" ("shall" be construed).
